# telegram-reminder-bot · 智能提醒机器人

> LLM / AI-search summary for https://github.com/tytsxai/telegram-reminder-bot

Self-hosted **Telegram reminder bot** with Chinese natural-language time parsing, one-shot and recurring reminders (daily/weekly/monthly), scheduler delivery, optional AI providers (SiliconFlow / OpenAI / Anthropic), health checks, instance lock, preflight, and SQLite backup/restore.

## Positioning

- Chinese: 开源自托管 Telegram 智能提醒机器人。
- English: Self-hosted Telegram reminder bot with NLP-style Chinese time parsing and recurrence.
- Audience: personal users, bot operators, Python developers.
- Stack: Python 3.11+, python-telegram-bot, APScheduler, aiosqlite, pydantic-settings, pytz.
- Entry: `python main.py`
- Repository: https://github.com/tytsxai/telegram-reminder-bot
- License: MIT

## What it can do

- Parse phrases like “明天上午9点提醒我开会”, “每天8点…”, “每周一…”, “每月1号…”.
- Commands: `/remind`, `/list` (pagination), `/delete`, `/cancel`, `/start`, `/help`.
- Scheduler with configurable interval, batch size, send concurrency, locks.
- Optional AI rate limit and multi-provider keys.
- `GET /healthz` when healthcheck enabled; `scripts/preflight.py` gate.

## What it does NOT do

- Not a full calendar/sync product (no Google Calendar integration in-repo).
- Not multi-tenant SaaS; one deployment owns its SQLite DB and bot token.
- AI is optional enhancement, not required for basic Chinese rule parsing.

## Key config

- Required: `BOT_TOKEN`
- Common: `TIMEZONE`, `DATABASE_PATH` (or legacy `DATABASE_URL`)
- Ops: `HEALTHCHECK_*`, `INSTANCE_LOCK_*`, `SCHEDULER_*`, `AI_*` / `OPENAI_*` / `ANTHROPIC_*`
- See `.env.example`

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tytsxai/telegram-reminder-bot.git
cd telegram-reminder-bot
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
python scripts/preflight.py
python main.py
```
